_comment: W6+SH probe rung 4 — the rank-gate tolerance (the BeiDou card's DG piece).

globally: gauge depth 6.9e-12, weakest-real layer 2.48e-02, suspect direction
9.78e-06, ev_max 1.03e+05.  tol 1e-12 puts the cutoff at 1.03e-07 — 4.8
